name: All_information_about_the_symbol
summary: This EA is a symbol information utility that displays comprehensive details about the current trading symbol including spread, swap, margin requirements, tick size, contract specifications, and session times. It does not open any trades and serves purely as an informational dashboard for traders.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个交易品种信息工具，用于显示当前交易品种的全面详细信息，包括点差、掉期、保证金要求、跳动点大小、合约规格和交易时段等。它不进行任何交易操作，仅作为交易者的信息面板使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个纯信息展示工具。它不包含任何入场条件或出场条件，也不执行任何仓位管理或资金管理操作。其核心功能是收集并展示当前交易品种的所有关键参数，如点差、掉期利率、保证金要求、跳动点值、合约大小、最小/最大交易量、交易时段等。该工具帮助交易者快速了解品种特性，辅助手动交易决策或策略开发。它不涉及任何自动交易逻辑，因此不适用策略分析框架。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a pure information display utility. It does not contain any entry or exit conditions, nor does it execute any position sizing or money management operations. Its core function is to collect and display all key parameters of the current trading symbol, such as spread, swap rates, margin requirements, tick value, contract size, minimum/maximum volume, trading sessions, and more. The tool helps traders quickly understand symbol characteristics, assisting manual trading decisions or strategy development. It does not involve any automated trading logic, so the strategy analysis framework does not apply.
pros: 提供全面的品种信息汇总，交易者无需逐项查找
界面直观，便于快速了解交易品种特性
有助于策略开发和参数设置，减少信息查找时间
pros_en: Provides comprehensive symbol information summary, saving traders from searching individually
Intuitive interface for quickly understanding trading symbol characteristics
Helpful for strategy development and parameter setup, reducing information lookup time
cons: 仅展示信息，不具备任何交易功能
缺乏自定义筛选或对比功能，信息量可能过大
占用图表空间，可能影响其他指标或EA的显示
cons_en: Only displays information without any trading functionality
Lacks custom filtering or comparison features, information volume may be overwhelming
Occupies chart space which may interfere with other indicators or EAs
improvements: 增加品种间对比功能，方便交易者选择最优品种
添加关键参数的预警功能，如点差过大或保证金不足时提醒
improvements_en: Add symbol comparison functionality to help traders select optimal symbols
Add alert features for key parameters such as high spread or insufficient margin warnings

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
信息展示可能因数据源延迟导致显示不准确
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, no trading risk
Displayed information may be inaccurate due to data source latency

summary_en: This EA is a symbol information utility that displays comprehensive details about the current trading symbol including spread, swap, margin requirements, tick size, contract specifications, and session times. It does not open any trades and serves purely as an informational dashboard for traders.
